subject: Fix switch case compilation error in the new helloscripting (#1472)
reason: The diff only wraps two switch-case bodies in braces inside tests/modules/helloscripting.c to fix a compilation error (declarations after a case label need a scope block). It is a build fix in a test-only module with no behaviour change: the executed instructions (ARGS, RETURN) do exactly what they did before, and no server code, command reply, replication, or persistence path is touched. No scenario can distinguish the two builds.
